load_hand_poses_from_jsonl: load hand poses from a JSONL file into a dictionary of HandPose3dCollection objects keyed by timestamp
parse_hand_poses_from_fileobject: parse hand poses from a file object line by line into a timestamped dictionary of HandPose3dCollection
load_hand_pose_as_json_lines: load hand poses as raw JSON dictionaries per timestamp from a JSONL file
load_mano_shape_params: load MANO shape beta parameters from a JSONL hand pose trajectory file
create_HandPose_dataclass: create a HandPose dataclass with handedness, wrist_pose SE3 transform, and joint angles list
